title: Payments Gateway PROD Core
summary: Payments production architecture uses API gateway, payment service, and ledger DB with strict latency SLO.
handover_notes: Gateway timeout alarms increased after the last release. Check upstream retry policy and circuit breaker thresholds.
runbook_steps: Check gateway 5xx and timeout metrics for 15m window.
Validate redis latency and connection pool saturation.
If timeout ratio > 2 percent, roll back gateway routing rule.

title: Payments Gateway PROD Security
summary: Production payments zone includes private service mesh, KMS envelope encryption, and privileged breakglass process.
handover_notes: Only breakglass role can modify egress policy. Audit log must capture all policy changes and approvers.
runbook_steps: Check policy change tickets from last 24h.
Confirm KMS key rotation status for payments namespace.
If unauthorized egress rule exists, isolate namespace and revoke token.

title: Payments STAGING Validation
summary: Staging payments architecture mirrors production with reduced traffic and synthetic card data only.
handover_notes: Use staging for canary validation before production rollout. Do not connect real partner endpoints.
runbook_steps: Run canary test suite with synthetic transactions.
Verify callback signatures from mock partner gateway.
Promote build only if failure rate < 0.5 percent.

title: Analytics PROD Pipeline
summary: Analytics production pipeline ingests events through Kafka and serves dashboards from warehouse marts.
handover_notes: Late arriving events cause metric skew during month-end close. Watch ETL lag and retry queues.
runbook_steps: Check Kafka consumer lag by topic and partition.
Inspect ETL job failures in orchestrator.
Backfill missing partitions before 09:00 UTC reporting window.

title: Identity PROD Auth Mesh
summary: Identity production architecture provides OIDC token issuing, JWKS publishing, and policy decision point.
handover_notes: Token verification traffic spikes during regional failover. Ensure JWKS cache refresh and HSM health are normal.
runbook_steps: Validate issuer and audience configuration in edge gateways.
Check JWKS endpoint error budget and cache age.
If signing latency exceeds threshold, fail over to standby signer.

title: Search DEV Sandbox
summary: Search dev environment runs sandbox ranking experiments with non-production index snapshots.
handover_notes: Experiment cluster is preemptible and may restart often. Keep configs in git and avoid manual hotfixes.
runbook_steps: Rebuild local index from approved snapshot.
Run relevance smoke tests before publishing experiment notes.
